faq.question: Is this the same as full-service management?
faq.answer: Account operations focuses on alignment across workstreams. Full-service management can also own day-to-day PPC, listing, and catalog execution under one team. Many brands start with operations alignment and expand.

faq.question: Can you coordinate our existing freelancers?
faq.answer: Yes. We can define priorities and hand-off rules across internal or external specialists. Deeper execution may move in-house when that is a better fit.

faq.question: How often do alignment reviews run?
faq.answer: Most accounts run a weekly operating board plus a monthly strategy review. Cadence is set during onboarding.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Submit the free audit form or contact us at +1 (360) 660-1210 or info@ecomgliders.com.
